body: **Foco:** Reporting passive — introdução.
**Pronúncia:** Ênfase intencional.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** poema, haiku ou letra.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo usar a passiva de relato (It is said that…, He is believed to…) para atribuir informações sem citar a fonte.

body: Esta aula treina **ler textos curtos e achar informação (IELTS Reading, TOEFL Reading)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: It Is Said
lines: It is said that the river never sleeps;
it is believed to carry every name it meets.
The city is reported to be growing fast,
yet nobody is thought to know its streets.
It is said that the old bridge has been standing since before the wars;
it is known to have held a thousand footsteps,
and is expected to hold a thousand more.

items.q: The poem says the river never sleeps.
items.why: It is said that the river never sleeps.

items.q: Everybody is thought to know the streets.
The bridge is expected to collapse soon.

items.why: It is said that = diz-se que.

head: Estrutura
Exemplo
rows: **It is said that** the river never sleeps.
The city **is reported to be** growing.
The bridge **is known to have held** crowds.

blocks.body: Verbos usuais: **say, believe, think, report, know, expect, consider, understand, allege**. A fonte não é citada: o foco é a **informação**.
Com *to have + particípio* a ação é **anterior** ao verbo de relato.

items.s: It is ___ that the river never sleeps. (say)
The city is reported ___ be growing fast. (to)
The bridge is known to ___ held crowds. (have)
Nobody is ___ to know its streets. (think)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

items.ans: The bridge is believed to be old
items.pt: “The bridge is believed to be old.”

body: **So the story goes,…** — Segundo conta a história,…
**The word on the street is…** — O que se diz por aí é…
**Rumor has it that…** — Corre o boato de que…
**By all accounts,…** — Pelo que dizem,…
**Reportedly,…** — Segundo relatos,…
**Allegedly,…** — Supostamente,…
**Pass into legend** — Entrar para a lenda
**Stand the test of time** — Resistir ao tempo
**Use the passive: “It is thought that…”.** — Use a passiva: “It is thought that…”.
**And with a subject?** — E com um sujeito?
**“The bridge is believed to be old.”** — “The bridge is believed to be old.”

forms: She reports from the city hall.

blocks.title: Poetry circle
lines: How do I say “people think” without naming them?
Use the passive: “It is thought that…”.
Use a passiva: “It is thought that…”.
“The bridge is believed to be old.”
“The bridge is believed to be old.”

items.label: Ênfase intencional
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.q: Report a rumor with It is said that.
prompts.model: It is said that the mayor will resign.
The building is believed to be unsafe.
The bridge is known to have survived the flood.

blocks.task: Write a 4-line poem or 5 sentences about a place using the reporting passive.
blocks.model: It is said that the café on the corner has served the same soup for fifty years. The owner is believed to know every customer. The recipe is thought to have come from her grandmother. The place is expected to stay open for another fifty.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
